My parents caved and continued making payments to now meet now “Y” amount.  They again checked in when they knew they were meeting amount and Bert again said we didn’t agree to “Y”, we agreed to “Z” which was an additional $4,000.  My parents confronted him and would not make any more payments and demanded title.  He stopped taking their calls and has not provided yearly auto registration and now the car has been sitting due to them not having registration sticker.
